statements.sql: select * from `component_masters` order by SUBSTRING(name, 1, 1) ASC

select * from `component_fields` where `page_id` is null and `component_fields`.`component_id` in (2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 11, 12, 16, 18, 19, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 28, 29, 30, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 39) order by `group` asc, `position` asc

select * from `component_fields` where `page_id` is not null and `component_fields`.`component_id` in (2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 11, 12, 16, 18, 19, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 28, 29, 30, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 39) and `page_id` = '1' order by `group` asc, `position` asc

select `component_masters`.*, `page_components`.`page_id` as `pivot_page_id`, `page_components`.`component_master_id` as `pivot_component_master_id` from `component_masters` inner join `page_components` on `component_masters`.`id` = `page_components`.`component_master_id` where `page_components`.`page_id` in (1) order by `page_components`.`id` asc
select * from `component_fields` where `page_id` is null and `component_fields`.`component_id` in (11, 33, 35, 36, 37, 39) order by `group` asc, `position` asc
select * from `component_fields` where `page_id` is not null and `component_fields`.`component_id` in (11, 33, 35, 36, 37, 39) order by `group` asc, `position` asc
select count(*) as aggregate from `notifications` where `is_read` = 0
select * from `notifications` where `is_read` = 0 order by `created_at` desc limit 5
